import json, pathlib, urllib.request, datetime

obj = json.loads(p.read_text())
access_jwt = obj['session']['currentAccount']['accessJwt']
did = 'did:plc:mrrtnc65nxgq6xzntkjzmjp7'
uri = 'at://did:plc:rgwguvzojjugcerqkcnyvah3/app.bsky.feed.post/3mq5hqvaik22s'
cid = 'bafyreiectpspyr2shhoabs3gys2f355kskfny4samoux5ltar76kipd6qq'
ts = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='milliseconds').replace('+00:00', 'Z')
body = {
    'repo': did,
    'collection': 'app.bsky.feed.like',
    'record': {
        '$type': 'app.bsky.feed.like',
        'subject': {'uri': uri, 'cid': cid},
        'createdAt': ts,
    },
}
req = urllib.request.Request(
    'http://localhost:3000/xrpc/com.atproto.repo.createRecord',
    data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
    headers={
        'Authorization': f'Bearer {access_jwt}',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    method='POST',
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    print(resp.read().decode())
